verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export or account-portability feature, and no open export formats. The general programmatic API is a developer building block, not an export capability. `LLMObs.export_span()` serves submitting evaluations into Datadog, not exporting data out, and the community reports of migrating away describe user-side moves rather than a product feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
